title: ATT Identification in Four-Period Binary Transition Models with Collided Terminal Rows
banked_reason: Sound one-collision benchmark and repaired D0.5 mathematics, but field-tier completion stopped at a deterministic artifact/output-channel mismatch: the D0 solve worker had no channel to deliver the required executable Collins/Sturm-Habicht certificate; referee-assessed tier incremental (score ceiling 5.4 below 7.4 field floor).
gap_reasons: The delivered result covers only the exclusive stratum with one specified collided control terminal row; its sixteen charts are orientation/alignment branches within that stratum, not the requested branch-complete atlas of terminal-collision patterns.

Point identification is characterized only by acceptance or rejection of a generic full Collins quantifier-elimination computation, rather than by the advertised explicit observable vanishing and sign conditions.
The checker confirms arithmetic on the proposed four leaves; it does not prove computationally that no fifth equality leaf exists.
The second response did not implement the explicitly requested execution certificate. It documented a future validity contract while leaving the fixture/checker byte-identical.
proof_attempt_summary: The run repaired the local CAD projection and domain defects, proved the compact one-collided-control-row classification, and produced an exact rational P-diamond regression fixture with 32 cells, eight accepted labels, 24 analytic exclusions, and two attained ATT values. The field-tier continuation required an executable Collins projection and signed Sturm-Habicht lifting certificate, but the D0 solve worker's authorized outputs could not contain an implementation; two retries therefore left the checker and fixture byte-identical. The mathematics remains sound at the referee-assessed incremental tier, while a future run needs a tool-capable implementation stage before re-review.
tldr: On the compact binary four-period model, the completed singular result is the exclusive stratum with distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one collided control terminal row. Terminal splitting reduces its forty-coordinate labeled fiber to sixteen ten-variable orientation/alignment charts for each collided state. A corrected full Collins certificate projects every pair in the complete polynomial family and exactly decides branch feasibility and aggregate-ATT constancy, including zero and box-face cells; it is a generic exact certificate, not the still-open compressed economic sign basis. The exact algorithm returns the attained, possibly disconnected sharp image with endpoint witnesses. Full-PMF inversion is uniformly honest in finite samples and remains auxiliary; no endpoint or Hausdorff consistency is claimed. An injective one-parameter family has two separated quotient ATT values, proving positive-dimensional persistence but not relative openness in a larger collision variety.
gap: Ahn--Kasahara's parameter and ATT identification results impose their stated RSM, M, ID, and TI--LT regular conditions, while Higgins and Jochmans's four-observation Theorem 1 requires rank, type-separation, and connectivity conditions; neither classifies the one-collided-control-row merger stratum. Geiger--Meek and Collins supply general real quantifier elimination but leave the economically meaningful two-arm branch structure opaque.
fill: The project proves the reduction, gives the observable \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}\) classification, computes the exact attained ATT image on all thirty-two labeled branches, and supplies an open singular chamber plus rational disconnected benchmark.
